text: US officials tell allies Putin has decided to invade Ukraine; final attack order expected within days, 150k+ troops staged around the border
At Munich Security Conference, Zelensky pleads for sanctions-before-invasion; Western leaders warn attack could come 'at any time'
Geolocated rail footage: echelons of tanks and BMPs arriving Belgorod oblast overnight, ~40km from Kharkiv
Putin signs decrees recognizing Donetsk and Luhansk 'republics'; orders Russian 'peacekeeping' troops into eastern Ukraine
US announces first-tranche sanctions on Russian sovereign debt and elites after recognition of breakaway regions in Ukraine
Scholz halts Nord Stream 2 pipeline certification in response to Russia's moves on Ukraine
Unmarked armor columns reported moving toward border crossings near Donbas contact line overnight
Biden calls Russian deployments 'the beginning of an invasion'; UK sanctions five Russian banks; Russian parliament approves force abroad
LA/LB anchorage queue steady at 38 container vessels; congestion unchanged week-over-week
Data-wiper malware (HermeticWiper) hits Ukrainian government and bank networks; websites down across Kyiv
Ukraine parliament approves nationwide state of emergency; conscription of reservists begins
State Dept spokesman: Russian invasion of Ukraine 'could begin before the end of the week', all units at readiness
Ukraine issues NOTAM restricting civilian flights over Kyiv FIR; airlines suspending Ukraine service
Russian Black Sea Fleet amphibious group departs Sevastopol; six landing ships now loitering west of Crimea
BREAKING: Putin announces 'special military operation' in Ukraine; explosions reported in Kyiv, Odesa, Kharkiv, Mariupol
Explosions heard across Kyiv; air-raid sirens sounding; residents fleeing city
Missile strikes reported at Odesa military airfield and port approaches; smoke visible over harbor district
Ukraine MoD: Russia has launched full-scale invasion; cruise and ballistic missiles hit airbases and command centers nationwide; martial law declared
Ukraine closes entire airspace to civil aviation; Moldova follows; all flights rerouted
Marshall Islands-flagged bulker YASA JUPITER struck by missile ~50nm off Odesa; vessel underway, one minor injury
Heavy shelling reported around Mariupol; columns of Russian armor crossing north from Crimea toward Kherson
USPA suspends commercial vessel operations at all Ukrainian ports including Odesa, Mykolaiv, Mariupol and Kherson until further notice
Russian warships shelling Snake Island garrison; border guards' radio goes silent after refusing to surrender
CBOT wheat limit-up +5%; Ukraine's Black Sea grain exports halt — country is world's #4 wheat shipper
AIS shows bulk carriers diverting from Ukrainian waters; anchorage congestion building off Constanța, Romania
UK MoD: heavy fighting on Kyiv approaches; unconfirmed reports of amphibious landings near Odesa and Mariupol
Russian armor advances on Kherson from Crimea; Dnieper bridges contested; Ukrainian army fighting for southern approaches
Moldova-flagged chemical tanker MILLENNIAL SPIRIT hit by missile in Black Sea south of Odesa; crew abandons ship
Photos circulating of Russian Ka-52 helicopters over coast south of Odesa; amphibious assault rumors unconfirmed
Japan-owned freighter NAMURA QUEEN damaged by shellfire off Odesa; third merchant vessel hit in Black Sea in two days
European TTF gas +36% on the week; Brent tops $105/bbl; insurers suspend war-risk cover for Black Sea shipping
ICRC: water and medical supply lines failing in Mariupol and Kharkiv; civilians sheltering in metro stations
TSMC schedules routine quarterly tool maintenance at Hsinchu R&D fab; no customer impact expected
US, EU, UK and Canada announce selected Russian banks to be cut from SWIFT; central bank assets targeted
Putin orders Russia's nuclear deterrent forces to 'special alert'; NATO calls move dangerous escalation
MSC suspends all cargo bookings to/from Russia effective March 1; Black Sea services to Odesa already halted
Rouble plunges ~30% after sanctions hit Russian central bank reserves; MOEX trading suspended; TTF gas +40%
Missile strike devastates Kharkiv's Freedom Square and regional administration HQ; at least 10 dead; 40-mile Russian convoy approaches Kyiv
Maersk suspends all new bookings to/from Russia except food, medicine, humanitarian cargo; Odesa calls remain suspended
Chipmakers on alert: Ukraine supplies ~50% of global semiconductor-grade neon; Odesa-based Cryoin's operations in doubt since invasion
Panama Canal transits normal; no draft restrictions announced for March
Kherson becomes first major Ukrainian city to fall to Russian forces; mayor confirms troops in city center
Ukrainian forces repel Russian assault on Mykolaiv, key gate to Odesa; city hit by cluster munitions
Odesa neon refiner Cryoin confirms production halt since Feb 24; staff evacuated; semiconductor customers notified
UN: Mariupol encircled and under 'unrelenting' shelling; no water, heat or power; humanitarian corridor urgently needed
Mariupol-based InGas, Ukraine's largest neon purifier, halts output amid siege; company supplies ~30% of global neon for lithography lasers
Black Sea tanker earnings triple on war-risk premiums; Aframax rates for Kozmino and CPC loadings hit record levels
Reports of heavy shelling at Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant, Europe's largest; fire visible at training building
Fire at Zaporizhzhia NPP after Russian shelling; reactors safe per IAEA but emergency crews fight blaze at Europe's biggest nuclear plant
IAEA: no radiation release at Zaporizhzhia; fire extinguished; 'normal operations at risk' as Russian forces control site
CBOT wheat +40% on week, biggest gain on record; palladium tops $3,000 on Russian supply fears; nickel squeeze brewing
Ukraine's two leading neon producers InGas and Cryoin halted as war closes in on Odesa; analysts warn chip supply tightness into 2023
War-risk premiums for Black Sea transits hit 5% of hull value; most owners refuse Ukrainian port calls; grain backlog ~25m tonnes
ISW assessment: Russian grouping in Kherson/Mykolaiv axis likely regrouping for push on Odesa; city digging in
Spot neon prices for lithography up ~2x since invasion; ASML and fabs scout South Korean and Chinese supply alternatives
